details: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is now available on Coinbase and Robinhood, significantly expanding its reach to both retail and institutional clients. This follows an investment-grade rating from Moody's for RLUSD. Ripple anticipates achieving an annualized product revenue run rate of $900 million by the end of 2026, driven by growth across its various services.
title: Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin Expands to Coinbase & Robinhood, Nears $900M Revenue

details: The U.S. Federal Reserve decided to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75%-4.00% following its October 28th meeting. The decision, passed with a 10-2 vote (with two officials advocating for a hike), coupled with warnings about persistent inflation, suggests a hawkish monetary policy outlook. This maintains restrictive financial conditions and leaves the door open for a potential rate hike in December, impacting risk-sensitive assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady, Maintains Hawkish Stance

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded $137 million in net inflows on October 28th, marking their third consecutive day of positive inflows and bringing October's cumulative flows back into the green. BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) led these inflows. Conversely, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs experienced another day of withdrawals, shedding $21 million, extending their outflow streak to three consecutive sessions. BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) contributed significantly to these outflows.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Inflows While Ethereum ETFs Face Continued Outflows
